issue.title: Capture prospective editorial dispatch states through an explicit native stdin evaluation seam

labels.name: ready-for-agent
labels.description: Fully specified, ready for an AFK agent

issue.body:
## What to build

Add an unshipped evaluation helper and preparation guidance for complete editorial state evidence. A bounded neutral probe on Codex0.160.0 nativev2 established that installed passive spawn PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks did not expose plaintext, while a fresh top-level native initial user item exactly preserved its supplied stdin. The matching parent/child sealed blobs establish only transport identity. Old checked inputs and diagnostics stay unavailable.

Use a deterministic task-local launcher of fresh `codex exec` with the full filled correction/checker brief on stdin. Capture exact bytes before launch, the authentic native initial user item, complete final assistant return, actual model/effort/version and fresh ancestry, owned process groups, raw receipts and cleanup. A prospective evaluator overlay changes only its named dispatch boundary, and is shared by both controlled arms. It supplies no expected finding, outcome, extra comparison or retry. It changes evaluation acquisition; no shipped editorial Skill semantics change is authorized.

Keep instrumented acquisitions and uninstrumented native parent observations separate. A semantic candidate claim requires independent complete source/artifact/terminal evidence and may not rest solely on the shim. Historical plans and verdicts remain frozen. Resolve the preparation gap exemplified by #493 with two stages: finite complete-contract fixture validation, then a committed final evaluation freeze after the validations and method capability pass.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The helper passes stdin bytes unchanged and proves equality against exactly one authentic fresh native initial user item; no summary, reconstructed draft, ciphertext or later echo substitutes for this receipt.
- [ ] Actual native context matches the frozen model, effort and CLI version; missing/duplicate/forged input, partial/truncated output, wrong seat and transport failure leave explicit unsuccessful receipts with no fallback.
- [ ] The full result is bound to that child’s completed turn and returned unchanged; ownership registration is immediate, timeouts stop only owned groups, and private authentication/runtime copies are removed after evidence capture.
- [ ] Meaningful focused tests cover Unicode/newlines, malformed or mismatched trace/input/result, seat verification, failures and owned cleanup; a bounded successful live neutral seam probe precedes any editorial matrix.
- [ ] Prospective controlled plans disclose the exact overlay, same-seat arms, full writable inventories and instrumented evidence limits. Original sealed rows remain unmet/skipped and are never called unprompted reproduction.
- [ ] Preparation requires two independent readers of complete fixtures against every actual loaded contract rule and separately counted/semantic anatomy; conformance expectations are frozen only after that preparation. Failed earlier controls remain preserved, with finite replacement bounds.
- [ ] New campaigns use distinct prospective canonical dated records; committed historical freezes and verdicts are not overwritten or regraded. The #493 mismatch is diagnosed from its actual full packet and the future method corrected without weakening body independence.
- [ ] Fresh independent verification supports the exact Main Seat gpt-6-astra/high only after a neutral actual capability receipt, without reusing a contaminated planner context or silently downgrading.
- [ ] Run the four checks in CONTRIBUTING.md.

---

Written against `4cf05813`.
